resources.string: This update is signed with a different key than the installed app (for example a build you compiled yourself and a build from GitHub). Android only installs an update signed with the same key, so the install would fail.\n\nTo switch builds, back up your data (Settings → App settings → Backup data), uninstall this app, then install the APK from the releases page.
This update is for %1$s, but this app is %2$s. Debug and release builds are separate apps, so it cannot update this one; install it from the releases page instead.
